variables_datatypes.objective: Understand variables, primitive data types (int, float, str, bool), and type conversion in Python.

control_flow.objective: Use if / elif / else statements and comparison operators to control program flow based on conditions.

loops.objective: Use for and while loops with range() to repeat operations and iterate over sequences.

functions.objective: Define reusable functions with parameters, return values, default arguments, and understand scope.

oop_basics.objective: Define classes, create objects, use __init__, instance methods, and apply single inheritance.
